title: First overdraft date
statementMd:
For each account whose running balance ever goes below zero, show the account id and the date of the first transaction that makes it negative.

Expected columns: `account_id`, `first_negative`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Running sum per account, then the earliest negative row.
solutionMd:
```sql
WITH r AS (SELECT account_id, tx_date, id, SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY tx_date, id) AS balance FROM transactions) SELECT account_id, MIN(tx_date) AS first_negative FROM r WHERE balance < 0 GROUP BY account_id;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
